name: Vertical short-form
summary: A full-screen 9:16 clip of 15 to 45 s, shot on a phone and cut every 1.5 to 3 s. A hook in the first second, burned-in captions and a sound that can loop. The feed decides each rule.

philosophy.core_thesis: A viewer swipes in 1 to 2 s, so every second must earn the next: the hook, the cut and the caption are the whole design.
design_principles: Frame in 9:16 at 1080 × 1920 px, 30 fps (24 or 60 allowed), 180° shutter, and fill the screen edge to edge.
Put the hook in the first 1 to 2 s: a face, a movement or a text line; the first cut comes by 3 s.
Cut or change the picture every 1.5 to 3 s: new angle, new scale, a punch-in of 10% to 20% or a new caption.
Keep faces and captions inside the safe zone: leave the bottom 20% and the top 7% of the height and the right 12% of the width clear for the interface.
Burn in captions of 1 to 6 words for each beat, at 48 px or larger on a 1080 px wide frame, 2 lines at most.
Shoot the main camera at 24mm (35mm format) at 0.3 to 1.5 m from the subject, with a ring light or a window at 5600K.
End so the clip loops: match the last frame to the first, and keep the run time at 15 to 45 s.
Mix to −14 LUFS integrated with the voice over a trending or looped sound.
anti_patterns: A horizontal 16:9 clip with black bars above and below
A slow intro or a logo before the hook
Captions under the platform interface or in the safe-zone margin
A wide establishing shot held for more than 3 s
A cinematic letterbox with a 2.39:1 crop
A voice with no captions on a feed that plays muted
A clip longer than 60 s with no change of angle

composition.framing: A full-screen 9:16 frame; the subject fills 40% to 70% of the height, with the face in the upper half.
composition.staging_in_depth: The subject within 0.3 to 1.5 m, a simple background at 2 to 3 m; one layer of text on top.
composition.subject_placement: Centred or on the vertical axis, with the eyes at 30% to 40% of the height from the top.

principles.rule: Compose for 9:16 and keep every face and caption inside the platform safe zone.
Put the subject at the centre of the vertical column, with one clear focal point in the first 1 s.
Stack the caption, the subject and the call to action in three tiers, top to bottom.
Cut on every beat or every phrase, and keep the shot short enough to hold a swipe.
Keep the lower 20% free of the subject so the platform UI does not cover it.

camera_and_movement.movement: Handheld selfie arm, a push-in, a whip pan or a spin as a transition; the phone is a part of the act.
camera_and_movement.support: Handheld selfie arm, phone gimbal or a tripod with a clip
camera_and_movement.camera_height: At the eye or slightly above, 1.5 to 1.8 m; low for dance
camera_and_movement.move_speed: Whip pan 180° per second; push-in 0.5 m/s

lens_and_format.focal_length: Phone main camera, 24mm (35mm format); ultra-wide 13mm for movement
lens_and_format.focus: Face autofocus; the phone gives a soft, computed background in portrait mode.

light.quality: Soft and frontal: a ring light, a window or a screen, with an even face.
light.direction: From the front and slightly above, with a bright face on a darker ground.
light.colour_temperature: 5600K daylight or a 5000K to 5600K ring light
light.source: Ring light, window or LED panel

colour_and_grade.treatment: Bright and punchy, with a clear face and a high-contrast, saturated image that survives compression.
grade_recipe: Set the black point at 4% and the white point at 98%.
Add contrast of +15% and keep skin at 60% to 75% luma.
Raise saturation by +15% and vibrance by +20%; the colour must survive heavy compression.
Sharpen at 20% and apply a built-in filter at no more than 50% strength.
Add no grain and no letterbox.
colour_and_grade.texture: Clean phone image with sharpening; noise under 3%

editing_and_rhythm.shot_length_range: 0.3 s for a beat cut to 6 s for a payoff
editing_and_rhythm.cutting_logic: Cut on the beat of the sound and on each new line. Change the picture at least every 3 s, and cut on movement.
editing_and_rhythm.transitions: Hard cut, a whip, a spin or an object wipe of 4 to 8 frames; no slow dissolve.
editing_and_rhythm.runtime: 15 to 45 s; loop at the end

sound.approach: The sound leads the edit: a trending track, a voice-over or a sound bite. Captions cover the muted viewer.
sound.dialogue: Direct address of 150 to 200 words per minute, or lip-sync to a sound.
sound.music: A looped track of 15 to 30 s with a drop at 2 to 5 s; keep it under the voice by 12 to 18 dB.

titles_and_graphics.treatment: Burned-in captions with one highlighted word, stickers and arrows, and a text hook at 0 to 2 s.
titles_and_graphics.type: Bold sans-serif at 48 px or larger on a 1080 px frame, white with a 3 px outline or on a colour bar; inside the safe zone.

shot_primer.opening: A face or a movement fills the frame at 0 s with a text hook in 6 words or fewer; the first cut comes by 3 s.

emotion.target_response: A quick hit of surprise and belonging: the viewer is in on the joke inside 3 s.

use_cases: video prompts for a vertical clip
avoid_when: The brief needs a cinema screen, a wide frame or a slow mood.
The piece must hold a long argument of over 60 s.

modifiers.how: Keep the vertical frame only if needed; move to one long flowing shot of 20 s or more and a graded look.
Keep the hook and the 9:16 frame; add a tape look, a date stamp and on-camera sound, and slow the cut to 3 to 6 s.

sources.title: Loudness reference: ITU-R BS.1770 and EBU R128 (levels in LUFS)
Platform creative guides (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube): safe zones change by app version, so check the current guide
